b: As someone who follows Indian chess, this makes me really happy!
We've watched Indian chess grow tremendously over the years, celebrated our players' victories, followed their journeys and witnessed India becoming a serious force on the global chess stage.
But there's so much more to these stories than just ratings, titles and tournament results. The struggles, sacrifices, rivalries, pressure and passion behind the board deserve to be told too.
Really excited to see CANDIDATES | INDIA'S CHESS STORY by Dopamine Media.
It's great to see Indian chess getting this kind of storytelling and recognition. Can't wait to watch it!
Hopefully, this is just the beginning of many more such projects.
Indian chess fans, are you excited about this? 🇮🇳
